Name: Angular Speedster Board 2000
Description: A lightweight 8.25-inch maple deck built for speed and street control. Features a medium concave, grippy matte grip tape and high-rebound trucks, making it a great all-rounder for park and street riding.

Name: Green Angular Board 3000
Description: 7-ply Canadian maple deck with a bold green finish. Slightly narrower at 8 inches, it flips easily and suits riders who focus on technical tricks.

Name: Core Board Speed Rush 3
Description: Performance deck with 90A urethane wheels and precision ABEC-9 bearings. Designed for fast downhill cruising and smooth carving on rough pavement.

Name: Net Core Super Board
Description: Our premium carbon-fiber reinforced deck. Extremely durable yet light, with a responsive pop and a stable 8.5-inch platform. Ideal for advanced riders and competitions.

Name: React Board Super Whizzy Fast
Description: Race-ready complete board with 52mm wheels, low-profile trucks, and a stiff 9-ply construction. Built to hold speed through long pushes and tight transitions.

Name: Typescript Entry Board
Description: A beginner-friendly complete skateboard with a forgiving 8-inch deck, soft 99A wheels and pre-assembled trucks. Everything you need to learn the basics out of the box.

Name: Core Blue Hat
Description: Classic six-panel cotton baseball cap in royal blue with an embroidered logo on the front and an adjustable strap at the back. One size fits most.

Name: Green React Woolen Hat
Description: Warm knitted beanie made from soft acrylic-wool blend. Fold-over cuff and a woven React label keep your ears cozy on cold winter sessions.

Name: Purple React Woolen Hat
Description: Stretchy ribbed beanie in deep purple with a fleece lining for extra warmth. Fits snugly under a helmet and washes well in the machine.

Name: Blue Code Gloves
Description: Padded riding gloves with reinforced palms and breathable mesh on the back of the hand. Touchscreen-compatible fingertips let you use your phone without taking them off.

Name: Green Code Gloves
Description: Insulated winter gloves with a water-resistant shell and silicone grip on the fingers. Elastic cuffs seal out the cold and the wind.

Name: Purple React Gloves
Description: Lightweight fingerless gloves with gel-padded palms to absorb vibration and protect from scrapes. Ideal for warm days and long rides.

Name: Green React Gloves
Description: Durable synthetic leather gloves with double-stitched seams and wrist guards. Offers solid protection while keeping full dexterity for board handling.

Name: Redis Red Boots
Description: High-top skate shoes in vibrant red with a suede upper, padded collar and vulcanized gum-rubber sole. Extra ankle support and excellent board feel.

Name: Core Red Boots
Description: Hard-wearing leather boots with a reinforced toe cap and shock-absorbing EVA insole. Triple-stitched for longevity, even with heavy griptape wear.

Name: Core Purple Boots
Description: Cushioned mid-top boots with a breathable mesh lining and a grippy cupsole outsole. Comfortable from the first ride, with no break-in needed.

Name: Angular Purple Boots
Description: Casual low-profile boots in purple canvas with a vulcanized rubber sole and padded tongue. A lightweight choice for everyday wear and light skating.

Name: Angular Blue Boots
Description: Waterproof blue boots with a sealed-seam upper and anti-slip tread. Keeps feet dry in wet conditions while still giving a good grip on the board.
